job.title: Leading hand
job.description:
Leading Hand – Formwork Construction

Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time

Overview

We are seeking an experienced and reliable Leading Hand to join our team in Brisbane. This is a great opportunity to take on a leadership role within the formwork construction industry, overseeing on-site operations and ensuring quality and safety standards are maintained at all times.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and lead a team of formworkers on site, ensuring the efficient and safe completion of daily tasks.
  • Plan and organise daily work schedules to meet project deadlines and requirements.
  • Ensure all work complies with safety protocols, quality standards and company policies.
  • Provide on-the-job training, support and guidance to team members.
  • Collaborate with site management and other trades to coordinate workflow and resolve issues.
  • Inspect formwork installation to ensure compliance with engineering and architectural specifications.
  • Maintain clear and accurate documentation relating to site operations and personnel.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience as a Leading Hand within the formwork or related construction industry.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of formwork systems, safety procedures and construction best practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
  • Excellent communication and organisational skills.
  • Current relevant construction tickets and certifications, including a White Card.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional trade qualifications or construction supervision certifications.
  • Experience working on large-scale commercial or civil construction projects.
  • First Aid certification.

What We Offer

  • Permanent full-time position with a reputable construction company.
  • Supportive work environment with opportunities for professional growth.
  • Competitive remuneration package based on experience and skills.
  • Opportunity to work on varied construction projects across Brisbane.

If you have the leadership skills and formwork experience to succeed in this role, we invite you to apply.

job.title: Estimator (Cladding)
job.description:
Estimator – Façade & Cladding

Location: North Lakes, QLD
Salary: $75,000–$95,000 + Super
Benefits: 12 RDOs per year + Company-Provided Computer
Employment Type: Full-Time | Permanent

Join a Leading Façade Installation Business

Siteforce Recruitment is partnering with a well-established façade installation business specialising in render, AAC (Gravis/Hebel) and fibre cement systems.

With more than 3,000 homes completed annually for Tier 1 residential builders across South East Queensland and Northern NSW, our client is looking for an experienced Estimator to join their team based at North Lakes.

About the Role

Reporting to the General Manager, you will be responsible for preparing accurate, competitive and timely estimates for render, AAC and fibre cement packages. You will play an important role in protecting project margins, supporting builder relationships and ensuring jobs are accurately priced before moving into scheduling and delivery.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Reviewing plans, specifications and engineering documentation to prepare detailed take-offs.
  • Pricing materials, labour, scaffolding, access equipment and consumables.
  • Preparing and submitting quotes within agreed timeframes.
  • Identifying scope gaps, exclusions, inclusions and potential project risks.
  • Pricing variations and ensuring approvals are recorded.
  • Liaising with builders, suppliers and contractors on pricing and specifications.
  • Supporting contract reviews and project handovers to scheduling.
  • Maintaining accurate pricing information, quote records and estimating procedures.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • At least 3 years' estimating experience in residential construction, façade, cladding or render trades.
  • Strong plan-reading and quantity take-off skills.
  • Working knowledge of render, AAC and/or fibre cement systems.
  • Experience with estimating software such as Cubit, Buildxact, Groundplan or similar.
  • Strong Excel skills and commercial awareness.
  • Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
  • Clear communication skills and confidence dealing with builders and suppliers.

Highly regarded:

  • Trade background in rendering, cladding or carpentry.
  • Experience pricing for volume or Tier 1 residential builders.
  • Knowledge of Dulux render and fibre cement systems.
  • Current driver's licence and White Card.

What's on Offer?

  • $75,000–$95,000 + Super, depending on experience.
  • 12 RDOs per year.
  • Company-provided computer.
  • Full-time, permanent opportunity.
  • Opportunity to join an established business with a strong pipeline of residential projects.
  • Work with a growing team and a range of leading residential builders.

Location: North Lakes HQ, with occasional site visits across South East Queensland and Northern NSW.

Apply Now

If you have residential construction estimating experience and are looking to join an established façade and cladding business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now with your updated resume.

Please Note: Only shortlisted applicants who meet the requirements will be contacted. If you do not hear from us, unfortunately, your application has not been successful on this occasion.

job.title: Carpenter for carports, patios, and decks
job.description:
Carports, Patios & Decks | Southside and Northside projects available

Same-Day Payments | Ongoing Work

Are you an experienced outdoor construction installer looking for consistent work with a reputable company? We are seeking skilled subcontract fitters to join our growing team installing high-quality carports, patios and decks across Brisbane and surrounding suburbs. Get given the jobs so you don't have to worry about finding them yourself. Then get paid the same day. No need to wait!

If you have experience constructing outdoor structures and take pride in delivering quality workmanship, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

You'll be responsible for constructing outdoor living projects from start to finish using premium Apollo and Ausdeck patio systems.

Projects include:

  • Carports
  • Insulated patios
  • Single-skin patios
  • Steel-framed composite decking

The majority of our decking projects use steel framing and composite decking, with very little timber work involved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Construct carports, patios and decks from start to finish
  • Read and interpret building plans accurately
  • Install steel framing, roofing and finishing components
  • Ensure all work complies with Australian building standards and local council requirements
  • Maintain a clean, safe and professional worksite
  • Deliver high-quality workmanship on every project

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience installing patios, carports or decking systems
  • Ability to read and follow construction plans
  • Current ABN
  • Own tools and reliable transport
  • Current White Card
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in your work
  • Ability to work independently and meet project deadlines
  • Willingness to travel throughout Brisbane and surrounding suburbs

What's on Offer

  • Highly competitive project rates
  • Same-day payment upon receipt of your invoice after successful completion of each project
  • Ongoing pipeline of work
  • Flexible subcontract opportunities
  • Supportive team and well-organised project scheduling
  • Opportunity to work on premium outdoor construction projects

While we always aim to schedule projects close to your preferred location, flexibility to travel throughout our Brisbane service region is expected.

If you're an experienced installer looking for ongoing work with excellent earning potential and prompt payment, apply today!

Please note: Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Australia and reside in Australia to be considered for this opportunity.

job.title: Commercial Site Supervisor - Hervey Bay
job.description:
Site Supervisor – Commercial Construction

Location: Hervey Bay, QLD
Employment Type: 6-month project, with potential for ongoing work
Rate: $65–$75 per hour or subcontractor arrangement, depending on experience

About the Role

Siteforce Recruitment is seeking an experienced, hands-on Site Supervisor to join a locally owned, award-winning construction company delivering commercial construction projects across Queensland. This role will oversee a major project in Hervey Bay, with potential opportunities for further work across the Wide Bay region and Queensland.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage daily construction site operations and coordinate site activities.
  • Supervise construction teams and subcontractors to ensure work is completed safely and efficiently.
  • Monitor project progress, schedules and quality standards.
  • Interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications.
  • Ensure compliance with WHS legislation, site safety procedures and relevant building standards.
  • Conduct site inspections and identify and address safety hazards.
  • Coordinate inspections, quality checks and Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).
  • Maintain accurate site diaries, attendance records and project documentation.
  • Liaise with project managers, subcontractors and client representatives.
  • Identify and resolve site issues proactively to support project delivery.

Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 2–5 years' experience as a Site Supervisor or Project Manager.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering commercial construction projects in Australia.
  • Current QBCC Site Supervisor Licence.
  • Certificate III in Carpentry and/or relevant project management experience.
  • Current First Aid and CPR certifications.
  • Valid White Card (Construction Induction).
  • Strong understanding of WHS, site compliance and construction quality requirements.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and organisational skills.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach with a strong commitment to safety and quality.

Project Details and Benefits

  • Initial six-month commercial construction project.
  • Potential for further projects across the Wide Bay region and Queensland.
  • Up to 50–60 hours per week, depending on roster and project requirements.
  • Rate of $65–$75 per hour or subcontractor arrangement, depending on experience.
  • Company vehicle and fuel card allowance.
  • Company iPad or laptop, as required.
  • Five high-visibility work shirts.
  • $80 monthly phone allowance for work-related use of a personal phone.

Location and Eligibility

The role is based onsite in Hervey Bay, Queensland. Local candidates are preferred. Applicants must be willing to relocate at their own expense if required and be based in Hervey Bay for the project.

How to Apply

If you have relevant Australian commercial construction experience and hold the required QBCC licence and safety certifications, please submit your current CV outlining your site supervision experience, project history and qualifications.

Important eligibility requirement:

Applicants must be Australian citizens. We are unable to consider international applicants, visa holders or candidates requiring sponsorship at this time.

Please apply only if you meet this essential requirement and the minimum criteria outlined in the advertisement. Applications that do not meet these requirements may not receive a response.

Thank you for your understanding.

job.title: Formwork labourer with FL
job.description:
Formwork Labourer – Forklift Licence Required

Location: Stones Corner, QLD

Our recruitment agency is seeking a reliable, hands-on Formwork Labourer with a current LF Forklift Licence to join our client's construction team in Wellington Point.

About the Role

This is a practical, hands-on construction role supporting formwork crews with the movement, handling and removal of formwork equipment. You'll assist with clearing and relocating gear after stripping crews finish, helping keep the site organised and work progressing safely and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist formwork crews with moving and handling equipment.
  • Help remove, clear and relocate formwork gear after stripping crews finish.
  • Operate a forklift to manoeuvre and position materials and equipment around site.
  • Provide general hands-on support to formworkers.
  • Maintain a clean, organised and safe worksite.
  • Follow site instructions and work collaboratively with the construction team.

About You

  • Previous formwork or construction labouring experience preferred.
  • Current LF Forklift Licence (essential).
  • Current White Card (essential).
  • Confident operating a forklift in a construction site environment.
  • Physically fit and comfortable with hands-on labouring and moving equipment.
  • Reliable, safety-conscious and able to work well within a team.

Key Requirement

We're looking for someone who can confidently operate a forklift while physically assisting formwork crews with moving, handling and relocating equipment.

If you have the right experience, licences and a strong work ethic, we'd love to hear from you!
